clips.title: The story
paras: Having proven skill across Stranglethorn Vale by hunting the region's deadliest predators, Hemet Nesingwary offers a final supreme challenge. The famed marksman asks for the head of King Bangalash, a great white tiger and the very reason Hemet is in the jungle at all.

After completing the trials set by the expedition's huntsmen—slaying Sin'Dall, Bhag'thera, and Tethis—Hemet Nesingwary acknowledges your martial skill. According to the veteran marksman, who compares your prowess to the finest displays seen from Lordaeron's battlefields to the jungle depths, only one hunt remains to prove your abilities unmatched: felling King Bangalash, the grand white tiger that serves as the expedition leader's true target.

Hemet reveals that King Bangalash is the reason he is in Stranglethorn Vale. The great beast has repeatedly driven the expedition leader himself back to camp in defeat. Presenting the beast's head would prove your hunting skill second to none.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend, you are a hunter worthy of our company. From the battlefields of Lordaeron to the deepest jungle, I have rarely witnessed such prowess with weaponry as you have demonstrated.

You have killed the ferocious Sin'Dall, the elusive Bag'thera and the treacherous Tethis. But the true prize is the head of King Bangalash. That white tiger is the reason I am here. I've had my sights on him for quite some time now. Kill King Bangalash and your hunting prowess is proven to be second to none.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Bloody well done! Right-o! Congratulations, friend, for succeeding where others have failed.
I am honored to count you as a comrade of our great hunting party here. No one will ever doubt your expertise in hunting and tracking!
Cheers to you, I say! Cheers!
